title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Ukraine: Kyiv launches 600-drone strike on Moscow — largest aerial attack of war, 6+ dead, Wildberries warehouse ablaze; risk-off watch Monday open.
Morgan Stanley +23% IBIT, +202% ETHA in Q2 13F; JPMorgan also raised crypto ETF stakes — institutional bid broadening despite ETF outflow streak.
FOMC minutes due Wed Aug 19 — markets consolidating at BTC $63K, ETH $1,880 ahead of release.
